description: Background jobs only: node-cron + database queue (default) or BullMQ/Redis (JOBS_USE_REDIS)

ops.content:
jobsUseRedis: process.env.JOBS_USE_REDIS === "true",
  redisHost: process.env.REDIS_HOST || "127.0.0.1",
  redisPort: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || "6379", 10),

model JobSchedule {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @map("id")
  jobClass  String   @unique @map("job_class")
  cron      String   @map("cron")
  paused    Boolean  @default(false) @map("paused")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  @@map("job_schedules")
}

model BackgroundJob {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @map("id")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  jobClass    String   @map("job_class")
  args        String?  @map("args")
  status      String   @default("pending") @map("status")
  queue       String   @default("database") @map("queue")
  source      String   @default("manual") @map("source")
  externalId  String?  @map("external_id")
  attempts    Int      @default(0) @map("attempts")
  maxAttempts Int      @default(3) @map("max_attempts")
  runAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("run_at")
  startedAt   DateTime? @map("started_at")
  completedAt DateTime? @map("completed_at")
  failedAt    DateTime? @map("failed_at")
  lastError   String?  @map("last_error")
  @@index([status, runAt])
  @@index([jobClass, createdAt])
  @@map("background_jobs")
}

# Jobs (irwin add jobs)
# JOBS_USE_REDIS=false
# JOBS_USE_REDIS=true
# REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1
# REDIS_PORT=6379

messages: Job runtime only — no admin UI (use irwin add admin-rbac for /admin/jobs).
Default: database queue. Set JOBS_USE_REDIS=true + Redis for BullMQ.
Cron: static `cron` on job classes (see app/jobs/heartbeat.job.ts).
Generate: pnpm exec irwin g job MyJob
